g.text: One instance per coil axis (X / Y / Z)

g.desc: One instance per coil axis (X / Y / Z)

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Thermal pad: solder to GND plane, thermal vias

g.desc: Thermal pad: solder to GND plane, thermal vias

g.text: VM = +34 V (36 V max). PWM_A -> IN2 -> OUT2 = coil +, PWM_B -> IN1 -> OUT1 = coil -.

g.desc: VM = +34 V (36 V max). PWM_A -> IN2 -> OUT2 = coil +, PWM_B -> IN1 -> OUT1 = coil -.

g.text: Power-up default is PWM mode; write MODE = 10b over SPI for independent half bridges.

g.desc: Power-up default is PWM mode; write MODE = 10b over SPI for independent half bridges.

g.text: SPI mode 1, 16-bit frames, one ~{SCS} per axis. Set ~{SLEEP} high, wait 1.5 ms, then configure.

g.desc: SPI mode 1, 16-bit frames, one ~{SCS} per axis. Set ~{SLEEP} high, wait 1.5 ms, then configure.

g.text: ~{FAULT} is open drain (low = fault). Clear with CLR_FLT or a short low pulse on ~{SLEEP}.

g.desc: ~{FAULT} is open drain (low = fault). Clear with CLR_FLT or a short low pulse on ~{SLEEP}.

g.text: DISABLE is shared by all three drivers: see the Panel_IO sheet.

g.desc: DISABLE is shared by all three drivers: see the Panel_IO sheet.

g.text: ITRIP 6.5 A at power-up, OCP 10 A (latched).

g.desc: ITRIP 6.5 A at power-up, OCP 10 A (latched).

g.text: Rds(on) 150 mOhm total: plan for about 3.5 A continuous per axis.

g.desc: Rds(on) 150 mOhm total: plan for about 3.5 A continuous per axis.

g.text: IPROPI (spare current monitor): 330 Ohm gives 0.30 V/A, magnitude only.

g.desc: IPROPI (spare current monitor): 330 Ohm gives 0.30 V/A, magnitude only.
